text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was the one who won the 
Kikuka-sho. With a ferocious run that 
overpowered all who watched, the 
grandstands erupted in tremendous 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian aims for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) after the Arima Kinen. Despite 
hearing such talk, Sakura Laurel insists 
on sticking to her own pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a form of trust. The one she 
admired would keep running ahead. That is 
why she wanted to prepare meticulously to 
overtake her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, breaking news spread 
that Biwa Hayahide had suffered an injury 
during the Tenno Sho (Autumn). It was also 
reported that all her future plans were 
wiped clean.
